Summary: Confirm proposal and scope
Acceptance criteria: Proposal identifies users, scope and exclusions; both members confirm.

Summary: Conduct 3-5 real user discussions
Acceptance criteria: 3-5 consented, dated discussions OR substantive real-client agreement; distinguish assumptions and findings.

Summary: Review scientific literature and matrix
Acceptance criteria: >=12 used sources, >=8 scientific; each has limitation and project implication; team reads and verifies core papers.

Summary: Review comparison of four existing systems
Acceptance criteria: 4 systems, 8 common criteria, primary source for capability claims; not-documented is not absent.

Summary: Select storage and document parser after review
Acceptance criteria: Compare >=3 technical decisions with 2-3 alternatives; record trade-offs and remaining pilot decisions.

Summary: Review functional and non-functional requirements
Acceptance criteria: Every Must has acceptance criteria and test; Kaisar reviews AI requirements.

Summary: Review architecture and API contract
Acceptance criteria: Three diagrams have editable sources and exports; API, components and data entities agree.

Summary: Review interactive UX prototype
Acceptance criteria: User can follow upload, confirmed criteria, results/evidence and error flow; mock mode visibly identified.

Summary: Approve verification corpus and baselines
Acceptance criteria: Rights-cleared corpus plan, two annotators, frozen split, metrics and baseline protocols recorded.

Summary: Connect GitHub and configure team access
Acceptance criteria: Repo accessible to both students; supervisor and committee access verified; GitHub connection can upload.

Summary: Create YouTrack project and import work items
Acceptance criteria: Actual tasks have real IDs, owners, priorities, acceptance criteria, due dates and links.

Summary: Review risks and project milestones
Acceptance criteria: Risk register covers parsing, cost, hallucination, access and evaluation dependencies.

Summary: Obtain supervisor review and apply revisions
Acceptance criteria: Supervisor comments are dated and linked to explicit decisions and actual revisions.

Summary: Make individual contributions and peer PR reviews
Acceptance criteria: Each student makes a genuine substantive change using own account; teammate reviews PR; changes link to actual tasks.

Summary: Prepare PDF of live YouTrack board and tasks
Acceptance criteria: One PDF shows actual board plus representative task details, including assignees and acceptance criteria.

Summary: Finalize report, access checks and submission tag
Acceptance criteria: Replace pending evidence, resolve comments, verify links; create prob-period-1 only at final agreed revision and export matching PDFs.

Summary: Implement Go upload and persistence API
Acceptance criteria: FR01, FR08, FR10-12 and relevant security tests pass on documented local setup.

Summary: Implement PDF DOCX extraction adapter
Acceptance criteria: FR02 and parser evaluation cases pass; retain provenance and reject unsupported scans.

Summary: Implement criterion normalization and evaluation
Acceptance criteria: FR03-07, FR11 and schema/evidence validation pass against fixtures; provider key server-side.

Summary: Implement Vue interface and Docker startup
Acceptance criteria: Real API integration replaces mock; error/empty/loading states and startup checks pass.

Summary: Run controlled evaluation and analyse errors
Acceptance criteria: Frozen test protocol executed; metrics and failures reported without tuning on test data.
